tavin.direction: Grounded, warm ranger with quiet authority

mira.direction: Reassuring young healer; clear and compassionate

lines.speaker: Tavin
lines.text: Easy. I know you. I won’t let this hurt anyone else.
Tavin’s people are distressed, not evil. He holds back to protect them.

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: The Light is a little brighter. The flow is beginning to settle.

lines.speaker: Station official
lines.text: Sharing observations before making corrections is helping. We can work on the damaged mechanism now.

lines.speaker: Bren
lines.text: We have our assignment. We follow the signs, and we listen.

lines.speaker: Tavin
lines.text: Together.
The road reaches the snowy region. The party carries Valenne’s interception assignment.

lines.speaker: Route marker
lines.text: The road continues toward Fern Hollow. Leave the local outskirts to enter the wider world path.

lines.speaker: Local representative
lines.text: I sent the report. The water’s unsafe, and the animals have been acting dangerously.

lines.speaker: Bren
lines.text: We’ll get people clear and secure safe water first.

lines.speaker: Soren
lines.text: Show us the water control.

lines.speaker: Local representative
lines.text: The gate is jammed and the pump is broken. Take the side lane to the waterworks.

lines.speaker: Bren
lines.text: It’s moving. Keep clear.

lines.speaker: Soren
lines.text: The gate’s free. The pump is still broken.

lines.speaker: Bren
lines.text: There. It’s flowing again.

lines.speaker: Local representative
lines.text: Thank you. We needed that.
A modest flow returns. Distressed wildlife is still threatening residents in the outer yard.

lines.speaker: Bren
lines.text: Get everyone behind us.

lines.speaker: Soren
lines.text: Keep them away from the homes.

lines.speaker: Soren
lines.text: I’ve seen the same pattern in old accounts. This reaches beyond Brookstead.

lines.speaker: Elder
lines.text: You’ve helped us. But we still don’t know what drove them here. Another report has arrived with the same symptoms.

lines.speaker: Bren
lines.text: Then we keep looking.

lines.speaker: Tavin
lines.text: Something is pulling at my people. I stopped them, but I haven’t found what’s causing it.

lines.speaker: Bren
lines.text: We’ve seen the water and wildlife change too.

lines.speaker: Soren
lines.text: Then we may be following the same disturbance.

lines.speaker: Tavin
lines.text: I’m coming with you. They need a cure, not another fight.

lines.speaker: Affected person
lines.text: It pulls at us. We can’t stop when it starts.

lines.speaker: Tavin
lines.text: Stay with me. We’re here.

lines.speaker: Soren
lines.text: I can suppress it for a moment. Help me hold this section steady.
The three stabilize the remnant. The attacks stop and the village’s Light returns faintly. The damage remains.

lines.speaker: Soren
lines.text: This section still responds. If I hold it steady, we can protect the village.

lines.speaker: Bren
lines.text: Then we do it together.
At activation, the responses converge under a single imposed command.

lines.speaker: Tavin
lines.text: It’s resisting you.

lines.speaker: Bren
lines.text: You said we were stabilizing it.

lines.speaker: Soren
lines.text: We are. A system that refuses to cooperate still has to be made safe.

lines.speaker: Bren
lines.text: You’re forcing it. Stop.

lines.speaker: Tavin
lines.text: This way. Stay together. Bren will keep the route clear.
Tavin leads the residents to safety while Bren protects the way through.
The villagers and party finish the remnant repair. A separate Elder Light waits in the secluded clearing. Its response is still flickering.

lines.speaker: Village representative
lines.text: Take our report to Highmere. The kingdom needs to know what happened.

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: Could you help me with those supplies?

lines.speaker: Bren
lines.text: Of course.

lines.speaker: Tavin
lines.text: Where do you need them?
The party helps Mira care for the arrivals, then tells her what happened in Fern Hollow.

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: I’ll come with you to the royal aid office.

lines.speaker: Bren
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: Guard
lines.text: Stay where you are. And if they lose control?

lines.speaker: Tavin
lines.text: They came here for shelter. Let them rest somewhere safe. I’ll stay.

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: Some of them need care. Your people do, too.

lines.speaker: Guard
lines.text: Temporary shelter. Your healer tends to everyone who needs her. And you go with our scouts.

lines.speaker: Tavin
lines.text: I’ll go.

lines.speaker: Bren
lines.text: Then let’s get them inside.

lines.speaker: Resident
lines.text: I knew where I was. Then, for a moment, I didn’t.

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: Does it come in waves?

lines.speaker: Displaced woman
lines.text: Yes. And my hands won’t stay still.

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: The same signs, in both of you.

lines.speaker: Bren
lines.text: Then this isn’t coming from her people.

lines.speaker: Guard
lines.text: Wait. Which way—

lines.speaker: Tavin
lines.text: Here. Take my arm. One step at a time. I’ve got you.

lines.speaker: Scout
lines.text: His hands. The people at the shelter were like that.

lines.speaker: Tavin
lines.text: That’s why we need to find what’s happening to the Light.
Once the guard can walk safely, the patrol reaches the clearing. The Light still burns, but its fractured, clouded facets are dimming.

lines.speaker: Tavin
lines.text: The Light is dimming. One of your scouts felt the same disturbance.

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: We’re seeing the same signs here, in both groups.

lines.speaker: Community leader
lines.text: Lysa went to look at the old remnant. She should have returned by now.
A pulse jolts the settlement. Plaster cracks and timber breaks loose beside the homes.

lines.speaker: Bren
lines.text: Away from the porch!

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: Come toward me. There’s room in the court.

lines.speaker: Bren
lines.text: I can hold this. Get them past.

lines.speaker: Tavin
lines.text: This way. Stay together.

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: Lean on me. We’ll take it slowly.

lines.speaker: Community leader
lines.text: We’ll keep them here, away from the damaged buildings. Lysa took the path to the remnant.

lines.speaker: Bren
lines.text: We’ll look for her.

lines.speaker: Tavin
lines.text: We’ll stay together.

lines.speaker: Lysa
lines.text: I saw someone forcing a pulse through it. The Commander said a superior wanted the section held.

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: You’re hurt. Let me help.

lines.speaker: Lysa
lines.text: I can still stand. I’m not letting them send another pulse.

lines.speaker: Bren
lines.text: Stay with us. We’ll stop them together.
The party and community complete the mechanism repair. The path east leads to the separate Elder Light; it still needs our help.

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: Let’s get Lysa home.

lines.speaker: Community leader
lines.text: You brought her back. Thank you.

lines.speaker: Lysa
lines.text: These notes point to the control brace. The kingdom should see them.

lines.speaker: Bren
lines.text: We’ll take the report and notes to Highmere.

lines.speaker: Station official
lines.text: The corrections are logged here. We’ve kept the refuge open through all of this.

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: The corrections come first. Afterward, the local Light dims or redirects its response.

lines.speaker: Bren
lines.text: That unsettled response. I felt it before, when the Light resisted being commanded.

lines.speaker: Tavin
lines.text: We need to see what happens when the corrections stop.

lines.speaker: Station official
lines.text: A brief pause in nonessential corrections. Normal shelter services stay running.
Under supervision, the relay remains at high output but the sharp surges stop. The Light’s signs become easier to read, although it remains dim.

lines.speaker: Station official
lines.text: We’ll share local observations before making further nonessential corrections.
Bren wakes with a fading sense of a voice—and a pull toward the Royal Archives. Bren cannot tell whether it was only a dream.

lines.speaker: Bren
lines.text: The archives. There may be something we haven’t understood.

lines.speaker: Archivist
lines.text: Read these together: an account of listening, a rare whisper, and a Light refusing a command.
The connected records describe a rare capacity for listening and cooperation. The Lights’ bond is not a shared bloodline or a guarantee of virtue.

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: Being chosen doesn’t decide what someone does.

lines.speaker: Bren
lines.text: Soren could still choose differently.

lines.speaker: Archivist
lines.text: The records are fragments. Take what you observed beside what they say.
The station mechanism is repaired. The separate Elder Light beyond the refuge can now be restored. Other affected areas remain unresolved.

lines.speaker: Commander
lines.text: The section is still resisting.

lines.speaker: Soren
lines.text: Then stop asking it.

lines.speaker: Bren
lines.text: You knew what commanding the Lights could do.

lines.speaker: Soren
lines.text: I knew what waiting would cost.

lines.speaker: Bren
lines.text: Stay. Help us stop this.

lines.speaker: Soren
lines.text: I can’t.
Soren leaves through a portal. The Commander continues the unfinished control attempt.
The component returns to its mechanism. The final Elder Light waits in the secluded clearing. Restoring it will let the region’s Lights answer one another.

lines.speaker: Tavin
lines.text: My people are safe. You’re all going home. Stay together.

lines.speaker: Bren
lines.text: And you?

lines.speaker: Tavin
lines.text: I need to know how far this has spread.

lines.speaker: Bren
lines.text: You don’t have to find out alone.

lines.speaker: Tavin
lines.text: I know.

lines.speaker: Council official
lines.text: Fern Hollow’s report is received. Alderbridge’s Light is still burning. Get there before that changes.

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: If people there need help, I want to come.

lines.speaker: Bren
lines.text: Then we go together.

lines.speaker: Council official
lines.text: One site reference in these notes matches a royal relief station. It is open and sheltering people.

lines.speaker: Bren
lines.text: We’ll investigate without putting the refuge at risk.

lines.speaker: Council official
lines.text: Your observations matter. We won’t extend this practice to other stations without stronger evidence.

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: The station staff are trying to protect people. We need to understand the response, not blame them.

lines.speaker: Council official
lines.text: Rest here while we deliberate.

lines.speaker: Council official
lines.text: The records may be real. They’re still fragments. They don’t tell us how to run every station.

lines.speaker: Bren
lines.text: We’re telling you what happened at the one we saw, alongside what the old accounts describe.

lines.speaker: Council official
lines.text: Credible, but not conclusive. We authorize a limited listening-first trial at that station. Return with the results.

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: The trial showed local healing. After that, the staff and party repaired the mechanism together.

lines.speaker: Council official
lines.text: The practice stays limited to that station. We’ll review what comes next carefully.

lines.speaker: Bren
lines.text: That unsettled response again. Closer this time.

lines.speaker: Tavin
lines.text: Then let’s go.

lines.speaker: Bren
lines.text: The unfinished command stopped. We returned the component and restored the local section.

lines.speaker: Council official
lines.text: This recovered field order points toward an operation serving Soren’s agenda in the snowy region. Intercept it before it advances.
The party accepts the assignment and prepares to leave for the snowy region.

lines.speaker: Council official
lines.text: Bring us the findings from your current investigation.

lines.speaker: Soren
lines.text: I won’t let another village be lost because we waited.

lines.speaker: Bren
lines.text: They’re resisting. You can’t save them by refusing to listen.
A cold light takes shape around Bren. Armor closes over him; his sword changes in his hand.

lines.speaker: Tavin
lines.text: Bren… what happened?

lines.speaker: Soren
lines.text: That wasn’t in the records.

lines.speaker: Commander
lines.text: Open the channel again.
A forced pulse reaches the nearby settlement and catches one of Tavin’s people in its pull.

lines.speaker: Tavin
lines.text: That’s one of my people.

lines.speaker: Bren
lines.text: Don’t go in alone.

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: Tell us what you need.

lines.speaker: Tavin
lines.text: Keep the others back. I’ll draw the pulse away. When I move, get them clear.

lines.speaker: Bren
lines.text: We’ll hold them. Go.
The Light responds to Tavin’s trust in the party. Keep building charge. Click Ascend when it is ready.

lines.speaker: Tavin
lines.text: They’re alive. I’ll find what’s doing this to them.
Bren and Soren arrive after Tavin’s encounter.

lines.speaker: Bren
lines.text: You can still help us stop this.

lines.speaker: Soren
lines.text: I can’t let it happen again.
Soren escapes after the exchange. His forced command destabilizes the remnant again. The residents need protection.

lines.speaker: Guard
lines.text: I felt it too. The same pull. I’m sorry.

lines.speaker: Tavin
lines.text: Now you know why they came for help.
Temporary shelter is granted. Immediate tension eases, though trust is still incomplete.

lines.speaker: Commander
lines.text: Fall back!

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: The pull has stopped. They’re coming around.
The Commander withdraws. The component taken from this site’s mechanism is recovered.
Tavin holds back to protect his distressed people. Bren and Soren are coming along the forest road.
The northern pass opens into the snowy region. The party carries Valenne’s interception assignment.

lines.speaker: Bren
lines.text: It’s worse than the report made it sound.

lines.speaker: Soren
lines.text: The water, the animals, the Light. Let’s hear what the representative has seen.

lines.speaker: Weapon shop clerk
lines.text: A good blade and a full satchel. What can I help you find?

lines.speaker: Innkeeper
lines.text: You look like you have come a long way. There is a warm bed and a meal waiting for you.

lines.text: I’m taking reports between the houses. There are more today than usual.

lines.text: The ground and the water tell you when something has changed.

lines.speaker: The elder
lines.text: Watch how the world responds. You can learn a lot by waiting a moment.
